title: Moving Average (Variable Frequency)
text: Variable frequency moving average-value computation, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial frequency (Hz)} sets the initial signal frequency, {Minimum frequency (Hz)} sets the minimum signal frequency, {Initial value} sets the initial input signal value and {Buffer size}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial frequency (Hz)
params.values: Initial signal frequency 60 (default) | positive scalar | vector with positive values

params.name: Minimum frequency (Hz)
params.values: Minimum signal frequency 30 (default) | positive scalar | vector with positive values
